messages.content: Calculate the derivative of the function 2x^2 at x = 1.

message.content:
The function is  

\[
f(x)=2x^{2}.
\]

Its derivative (using power rule \(d/dx\, [ax^{n}] = anx^{\,n-1}\)) is  

\[
f'(x)=2 \cdot 2x^{\,1}=4x .
\]

Evaluating this at \(x=1\):

\[
f'(1)=4(1)=\boxed{4}.
\]
